subject.title: [Bug]: Bootstrap files in agentDir are silently ignored — only workspace directory files are injected into system prompt

question: Should explicitly configured `agentDir` files ever become bootstrap prompt authority, or should OpenClaw keep workspace as the only bootstrap source and warn on misplaced files?
rationale: Current main and docs treat workspace files as prompt context and agentDir as state/auth storage, while the open PRs implement conflicting policies that affect safety-rule authority.

options.title: Keep Workspace Canonical With Warnings
options.body: Land or repair the warning-only path so misplaced agentDir bootstrap files produce a clear diagnostic without changing prompt authority.

options.title: Promote Explicit AgentDir Bootstrap
options.body: Accept agentDir as prompt authority only with precedence docs, diagnostic alignment, focused regression tests, and redacted live-run proof.

options.title: Defer Until Bootstrap Policy Is Designed
options.body: Keep the issue and PRs paused until maintainers settle the broader workspace versus state-directory boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep Workspace Canonical With Warnings
recommendation.body: Land or repair the warning-only path so misplaced agentDir bootstrap files produce a clear diagnostic without changing prompt authority.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and repeatedly maintained the central bootstrap resolver and workspace-bootstrap documentation that define the current boundary.
